evidence.quote: We install humidity sensors in all four greenhouse bays before the first frost
Bay two gets the pilot unit first

observations.why: Planned installation before a future frost, with specific named bays and units; the plan is irrealis, not yet actual.

evidence.quote: The sensors report every fifteen minutes
anything slower misses the overnight drop

observations.why: Present-tense settled claim about device behavior, generalized to any slower interval; the generalization makes it abstract.
